name: prepon
description: Builds and reviews UI that fits the project and its users, cites UX principles, and catches generic AI-styled interfaces.

slop_hook.title: Slop check after every UI edit
slop_hook.description: Run the slop detector on each UI file Claude edits, in every project, and report findings back. Off = only projects that opt in with a .prepon/hook-on file (or PREPON_HOOK=1).
